mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity across consumer and manufacturing sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase by at least 1% over prior 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Early-stage economic recovery (defined by two consecutive quarters of positive real GDP growth) signals accelerating corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive quarters, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing expansion (INDPRO growth exceeding 0.5% for two consecutive months) signals improving corporate production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase and federal funds rate decrease signal recessionary distress prompting aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls simultaneously over prior 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
